event_chain.summary: Publishing error: record-level data hidden in public web reports

summary: The District of Columbia Department of Health Care Finance (DHCF) found on July 21, 2026 that two public-facing reports on its website, which showed only aggregate Medicaid and DC Healthcare Alliance enrollment statistics, carried hidden record-level personal data that could be reached without authentication. The data covered 399,086 beneficiaries enrolled from 2023 to 2026: Medicaid ID numbers, dates of birth, provider names, race, gender, ward, and ethnicity. The reports had been publicly accessible since 2023. DHCF removed them and reported the breach to HHS on September 3, 2026.
